summary: Frontend-only testing of 'Vista Pulita Operatore' (role separation Capo vs Operatore) on the preview URL. All 5 requested scenarios PASS. Admin (Capo) sees Capo quick commands (braccio-quick-banco, braccio-quick-aggiungi) and all 6 Elite Engine rooms with no locked badge and can switch rooms (verified switch to PASTICCERIA). Operatore (operatore@mikilab.de, dept=forni) sees the clean lab: both Capo commands absent, Elite launcher + hands-free system present; Elite Engine shows NO elite-room-* buttons and shows data-testid='elite-locked-dept' with text '🔒 Reparto assegnato · 🔥 FORNI SINCRONIZZATI 3D' and overlay content forced to FORNI (cannot switch department). Guest/unauthenticated view keeps the full Capo commands. Label sync verified: bottom nav maestro tab = 'Chef Mode' (EN), site menu maestro entry + site-menu-title = 'Chef Mode · Lab', Home CTA home-chef-mode = 'Chef Mode · Lab' and navigates to the operative lab. Only blocker found: documented ADMIN password was wrong.

minor.issue: admin@mikilab.de / Test1234! returns 401 'Credenziali non valide'. Working password is Mikilab2026!. /app/memory/test_credentials.md and the review request were both stale; I corrected the memory file.

ui_bugs.issue: Side menu overlay does not close on Escape key; only site-menu-close closes it. While open, the full-screen overlay intercepts header/nav clicks (blocked header-logo-home during automation).

issues: Locked badge label is Italian-only ('Reparto assegnato') while the rest of the UI rendered in EN — not trilingual like other labels
No 'home' tab in bottom nav (My Recipes, Science & Guides, Chef Mode, Community, Quick Guide); Home is only reachable via header logo — noted for future test scripts, not a defect

critical_code_review_comments: MikiLabEliteEngine: isLocked = locked && ROOM_IDS.includes(lockedDept). If operatorApi.getProfile() fails or department is empty/invalid, an operatore gets the FULL room selector (fail-open). Make it fail-closed: when locked=true but dept unresolved, still hide the selector and show a 'reparto non assegnato' state.
BraccioLab: operatorApi.getProfile() error is swallowed with .catch(() => {}) — no loading/error state, and the lock silently degrades to unlocked.
MikiLabEliteEngine.jsx is a very large single file (room data + UI); consider extracting rooms3D data into a separate module.
